back: Physical resources: land, water, forests, buildings, machinery, vehicles, stock, money.
Non-physical resources: knowledge, skills, expertise, experience, reputation, goodwill, contacts.
The ability of an enterprise to combine and use its resources to do an activity well.
Identify gaps, choose suitable opportunities, plan acquisition, use resources efficiently, support a business plan, persuade lenders.
Buying, renting/leasing, hire purchase, loans, partnership or joint venture, inheritance, government allocation, training.
Meeting today's needs without destroying resources for the future (e.g. replanting, saving water).

front: Resource or capability: a sewing machine?
back: Resource. Producing well-fitting uniforms on time is the capability.
